The Net Present Value (NPV) or cumulative cost of the following com ponents over a 10-year lifecycle will be used to determine the Lowest Ranked Bidder (L1): · Initial Capital Cost: Cost of the main equipment (Digital Radiography Syste m), including all standard and requested accessories. · Comprehensive Warranty: Included in the base cost for the first Three (3) ye

ars from the date of satisfactory installation. · Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC): The cost of CAMC for the subsequent five (5) years (Years 4 to 8) must be quoted year-wise. · Consumables & Essential Spares: Fixed pricing for high-wear components a nd proprietary consumables for the entire 10-year lifespan. 2. Warranty and Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC) · Scope of Coverage: Both the 3-year warranty and the subsequent 5-year CA MC must be fully comprehensive. This includes all major components: The Fla t Panel Detectors (FPD), High Frequency X-ray Generator, X-ray Tube, workst ations, console software, and all peripheral accessories (e.g., online UPS, serv o voltage stabilizer, dry laser printer, and lead aprons). · Software Upgrades: All software patches, optimizations, and platform upgra des released by the Principal OEM must be installed free of cost within one (1 ) month of release throughout the 10-year lifecycle. 3. Uptime Guarantee, Penalties, and Liquidated Damages · 98% Uptime Mandate: The bidder must guarantee an equipment uptime of 9 8% calculated over 365 days a year. · Warranty Extension Penalty: If downtime exceeds the permissible 2% limit ( approx. 7 days per year) during the warranty period, the total warranty perio d will be extended by twice the excess downtime period at no additional cost to the hospital. · CAMC Financial Penalty: During the CAMC period (Years 4 - 8), any downtim e exceeding the 2% threshold will attract a daily financial penalty deducted fr om the annual CAMC payment, in addition to the mandatory extension of the service period. 4. Supply Chain, Spares, and Regulatory Compliance · Spares Availability: The principal manufacturer/bidder must submit a legal u ndertaking guaranteeing the availability of authentic spares, reagents, consu mables, and accessories for a minimum lifecycle of ten (10) years. · OEM Service Undertaking: The principal manufacturer must provide an expli cit undertaking stating that they will directly assume full responsibility for ma intaining and servicing the equipment if the local Indian agent or authorized s upplier fails to fulfil their service obligations. · Regulatory Shielding & QA: The successful bidder is entirely responsible for executing site modifications, wall/door radiation shielding according to AERB norms, and providing Quality Assurance (QA) analysis reports as part of the fo rmal installation process. Continuous QA/QC compliance stays within the scop e of the vendor 5. Payment Terms & Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) · Capital Cost Disbursement: Payment for the initial equipment and turnkey ci vil works will be released upon successful installation, commissioning, AERB li censing support, and satisfactory performance verification by the HOD of Rad iology.

· CAMC Payments: CAMC fees for Years 4 through 8 will be paid on a semi-an nual or annual basis in arrears, subject to the verification of the 98% uptime l ogs. · Performance Security: The successful bidder shall deposit a Performance Ba nk Guarantee (PBG) equivalent to a specified percentage of the total contract value. This PBG must remain valid through the entire 5-year warranty period plus an additional 60 days, to be renewed or adjusted during the subsequent CAMC period. 6.TECHNICAL EVALUATION (PHYSICAL DEMONSTRATION) · Finality of Specifications: The technical and operational specifications establi shed in this ATC document are absolute and final. No post-bid alterations or d eviations will be accommodated. · Mandatory Statutory & Safety Certifications: Bidders must submit verified, v alid documentation certifying that the equipment fully complies with the follo wing institutional benchmarks: Electrical Safety Standard: Valid certificate of compliance with IEC/EN 60601-1 or equivalent Bureau of Indian Standards (BI S) metrics · Regulatory Testing Standard: Verifiable test report and valid manufacturing/ import authorization for the product as per the Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2 017 (as amended till date). · Mandatory Physical Demonstration: A physical demonstration of the offered equipment is compulsory to validate performance claims. Virtual or video-bas ed demonstrations will be summarily rejected. · Objective Evaluation Matrix: The Technical Evaluation Committee will grade the physical demonstration against a strict, non-negotiable, objective "Pass/F ail Matrix" tied directly to the published ATC specifications (e.g., absolute par ameter counts, throughput rates, flagging efficiencies, and LIS bidirectional c onnectivity). Any single specification mismatch or performance lag identified during this demonstration will result in immediate technical disqualification. · Demonstration Logistics & Boundaries: Bidders must arrange and successful ly conduct the physical demonstration within seven (7) days of receiving an o fficial notification from ---- · Demonstration Expenses: All financial overheads, logistics, reagents, contro ls, calibrators, and incidental costs arising from the physical demonstration m ust be borne entirely by the bidder. . 14.
